assumptions: No platformer runtime is registered; this is an experimental fixed-step package.

World units use platforms [x,y,width,height] and increase y downward; player position is capsule center-x/feet-y. Screen projection uses the same y-down orientation; capsule bounds are [x-radius,x+radius] by [feet-height,feet]. Checkpoint is projected at its world-space feet position.
Physics defaults: move speed 5 units/s, jump speed 9 units/s, gravity 24 units/s², capsule radius 0.3, height 1.5.
Landing is one-way top-surface collision; falling 12 units below the lowest platform respawns at checkpoint.
Checkpoint defaults to spawn and can be set while grounded.
Corrected platform tuple use, declared platform/checkpoint adaptation and aligned renderer geometry to authoritative platforms/capsule; added same-instance fixed-step acceptance hooks.
Public move vectors [dx,dy] map dx to the platformer horizontal movement axis; jump and checkpoint type actions normalize to their existing boolean inputs.

Space jump, C checkpoint, R restart, and P pause respond once per physical keydown; repeated keydown events while held are ignored. COLLIDE is reported on each fixed simulation tick while contact persists, not only on begin-contact.
render_coordinates: World +y projects downward to screen +y. Platform tuple y is the top surface; player y is capsule feet; capsule top is player.y - capsule.height. Checkpoint marker uses the same y-down world projection.
